title: Free DocSend Alternative | RoundOS
excerpt: RoundOS gives founders tracked deck links and investor data rooms for free instead of charging for basic sharing.
content_html:
DocSend alternative

Everything DocSend charges for is free here.

Tracked links, page-by-page analytics, branded data room, NDA gating, unlimited seats. $0, permanently.

Line by line, at their published prices.

RoundOS. Same room, same analytics, same NDA gate, every seat included.

A real data room, not a folder with a password.

Everything DocSend puts behind its data-room tier, on the free plan.

Sections in reading order

Deck, metrics, model, cap table, contracts. Numbered, so a partner works down the room instead of emailing you for files.

Permissions per file

The cap table stays locked until the conversation is real. Release it to one investor without opening it to the other thirty.

NDA at the door

Signed before entry, countersigned copy stored against the visitor. No separate signature tool, no chasing PDFs.

Expiry and revoke

Kill a link the day a thread dies. Access ends mid-session, including for anyone it was forwarded to.

Versions, not attachments

Replace deck v7 with v8 and every link already sent serves the new file. Nobody is reading last month's numbers.

A named record of every view

Who opened which file, for how long, how often, and where it went inside the fund. On your domain, with your logo.

DocSend alternatives, answered

Yes. Tracked links, page-by-page analytics, the branded room, NDA gating, per-file permissions and every team seat cost nothing, with no trial clock and no visit cap.

Upload the same files and generate new links. Old links from your previous tool keep working until you revoke them there.

History from another vendor cannot transfer, so most founders switch between rounds or at the start of one.

Storage, single file size and active room count are capped. Links, viewers and analytics are not.

On published annual rates, Personal is $10 per user per month, Standard $45 per user per month, Advanced $150 a month for three users, and Advanced Data Rooms $180 a month. Monthly billing runs up to 40% higher, and a fourth user on either Advanced tier adds $90 a month. Data rooms, NDA gating and dynamic watermarking start at Advanced, so a founder who needs an investor room is on a $150 plan minimum. Startup discounts apply to year one only and renew at full price.

Yes. RoundOS gives you unlimited tracked links, one per investor, with time-per-slide analytics, revisit and forward tracking, version control and a branded investor room, on a free plan with no trial clock. No card, no trial, no per-seat charge.

They see a normal branded link, and an email or NDA step only if you asked for one. Tracking is standard practice at every stage of venture fundraising, and most partners assume any link they open is measured.

Stop paying to send a deck.

Free room and tracked links in two minutes.
